title: Vandermonde row-space density
statement: Let an executable Vandermonde input have independence order $k$ and output dimension $n$. Its associated probability density on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ is the density obtained from the row span of the executable Vandermonde matrix.
hypotheses_covered: Input has an independence order $k$ with $1\le k\le n$
